title: Curvegrid Payroll
tagline: Spreadsheet-driven payroll tool with instant cross-chain USDC salaries & automated DeFi integration.

prizes.title: Implement Hooks for CCTP V2 Transfers

description:
Curvegrid Payroll simplifies global payroll using an intuitive, spreadsheet-based interface.

Key Features:
- Pay salaries instantly across multiple blockchains using USDC.
- Eliminate expensive wire fees and complicated cross-chain management.
- Employees receive salaries seamlessly in their preferred tokens and chains.
- Option to automatically deposit salaries into DeFi protocols (like Aave), earning significantly higher interest compared to traditional banks.
how_its_made:
Curvegrid Payroll is constructed through a seamless integration of multiple advanced technologies:

Curvegrid MultiBaas: Acts as the core transaction management platform, securely handling the payroll transactions and interactions with various blockchains.

Curvegrid CloudWallet: Ensures secure management of crypto assets and private keys, providing robust security without compromising ease of use.

Circle’s USDC Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP v2): Facilitates reliable and smooth cross-chain transfers of USDC, allowing instant payments across supported blockchain networks with minimal latency.

Employers interact with the payroll system via a custom Google Sheets user interface connected directly to MultiBaas. This integration enables non-technical teams to effortlessly set payroll parameters, such as employee addresses, payment amounts, and preferred blockchain networks.

Custom-built Hooks automate advanced functionalities, including token swaps and immediate deposits into DeFi protocols. These features empower employees to start earning yields instantly upon receiving their salaries.

By leveraging Curvegrid and Circle’s technologies, we provide an intuitive and secure payroll solution that effectively bridges Web2 usability and Web3 functionality.
